params.body:
## Why

Every other repo runs its tests on GitHub Actions; KUBO was the one on CircleCI. Beyond consistency there is a measurable cost: Elixir's `ci` measurement reads the last completed **GitHub Actions** run on main as the project's CI, so on CircleCI the tests were invisible to Portal, and the `ci` gate of the automation ceiling could never open for this project. The README badge also still pointed at the old repo name `kubo-global/kubo`.

## What

- `.github/workflows/tests.yml`: the same steps CircleCI ran (clone the `kubo-kolibri` sibling, `composer install`, `.env` + key, `vendor/bin/phpunit`) on PHP 8.5 via `shivammathur/setup-php`, on every push and pull request, with a Composer cache and cancel-in-progress per ref.
- `.circleci/config.yml` removed. Disconnect the project on the CircleCI side when this is merged, otherwise it keeps reporting a missing config.
- README badge and the CI line in CLAUDE.md updated.

## Checked

The workflow runs on this PR itself: the **Tests** check below is the proof. Nothing in the application changes.
params.title: CI: run the tests on GitHub Actions instead of CircleCI
